paragraphs.text: The Nobles' Quarter is the part of Ki'pamu , capital of Zhalfir , that houses the citys' elite. Full of mansions and towers, the Nobles' Quarter is home to nobles and guild wizards , and sees a fair amount of intrigue among rivaling houses.
In the time before Mangara's Harmony , the Civic Guildmage Sabul Hajeen summoned the angel Kotara to the Nobles' Quarter to avenge the death of his brother.
↑ Richard Lee Byers - The Angel of Vengeance , The Colors of Magic (1999), Wizards of the Coast
